prompt: A translucent spectral warrior of pale cerulean ghost-light, an armored Spirit with a faintly glowing sword, striding forward in a low three-quarter view facing north-east. A solid living soldier in dented steel plate armor lunges and thrusts a steel spear at him, but the spear passes straight through the phantom's incorporeal chest and out the other side, the soldier stumbling off-balance, his block useless against the ghost who advances unbothered. Ghostly blue mist trails from the phantom's translucent body. The background is a moonlit battlefield at night, dark earth and broken banners, the only light the phantom's cold blue glow.

A lone translucent spirit warrior wrought entirely of glowing pale cyan ghost-light, an incorporeal armored swordsman in side profile facing east, mid-stride, sword raised, his body see-through so the background shows faintly through his torso and legs. Wisps of cold blue spectral vapor stream off his armor and trailing edge. The background is a deep indigo night sky over a dark ruined field, the only source of light the warrior's own ethereal blue luminescence haloing him.

A translucent glowing cyan spirit warrior, an incorporeal armored ghost, strides straight forward toward the viewer through a line of three solid living soldiers in dark steel armor holding raised shields. The phantom's see-through body overlaps and passes through their shields and bodies as if they were not there, the soldiers recoiling in alarm, their shield wall useless. All four figures fully visible. The phantom is centered and largest, lit by its own cold blue ghost-light. The background is a torchlit fortress gate at night.

A solid living soldier in dented steel plate armor lunges in a deep side profile facing east, driving a steel spear with both hands into the chest of a translucent glowing cyan spirit warrior. The spear passes clean through the phantom's incorporeal body and its bloodless point emerges from the ghost's back, the strike landing on nothing solid. The unharmed phantom keeps advancing, sword raised, see-through and wreathed in cold blue spectral mist. Both figures fully visible head to knee, the same size. The background is a moonlit night battlefield with a dark broken wall, the only light the phantom's blue glow.

Close shot of a translucent glowing cyan spirit warrior looming large and advancing toward the viewer, his incorporeal armored body see-through. A solid living defender swings a steel sword that slices clean through the phantom's translucent waist, the blade visible on both sides of the ghostly body, cutting nothing solid. The phantom is unharmed, eyes cold, sword lifted. Cold blue spectral mist pours off him. The background is a dark moonlit rampart at night, the only light the phantom's icy blue glow.

A translucent glowing cyan spirit warrior with a sword has slipped past a defensive line and now strides ahead of it in the foreground, side profile facing east, his incorporeal body see-through and trailing cold blue mist. Behind him two solid armored soldiers in dark steel spin around too late, weapons raised at empty air, unable to stop him. All three figures fully visible. The phantom is largest and lit by his own icy blue ghost-glow. The background is a moonlit stone courtyard at night.

Two figures on a moonlit night battlefield, both fully visible head to knee, the same size. On the left a solid living soldier in dented steel plate armor and a red cape, mid-lunge, thrusting a steel sword forward. On the right a translucent glowing cyan spirit warrior, an incorporeal armored ghost, advancing; the soldier's sword passes harmlessly through the phantom's see-through torso. The phantom trails cold blue spectral mist and raises his own glowing blade. A torn red banner stands at the right edge. The only light is the phantom's icy blue glow and the moon.

Wide shot. A translucent glowing cyan spirit warrior charges across the foreground from right to left, side profile, his incorporeal armored body see-through and streaming cold blue mist, sword extended. He has broken through a row of three solid dark-armored soldiers who stand frozen and useless behind and to the right, their spears lowered too late. All four figures clearly visible, the phantom largest in front. The background is a moonlit ruined battlefield at night, the only bright light the phantom's blue ghost-glow.
